thread:
Nora Lee: FYI I opened a tiny consolidation PR for Dedicated docs: short migration checklist (reserved -> dedicated), an autoscale FAQ blurb, and a compact SDK example showing tenant labels + isolation. Link: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/5019. Looking for wording on SLA + eviction note.

Diego Alvarez: Nice. One wording nit: avoid 'best-effort' alone. How about: 'Dedicated capacity carries SLA-backed latency targets; fallback/burst tiers are not SLA-backed and may be preempted.' Add a sentence about scheduled maintenance.

Priya Singh: For the YAML snippet please include an explicit label example. Folks always miss it. e.g.
```
allocation:
  name: team-horizon
  labels:
    tenant_label: "team-horizon"
    isolation: "tenant"
```

Tom Becker: SDK snippet I tested locally, here's a tightened Python example you can paste under "Programmatic provisioning":
```python
from redwood import DedicatedClient
client = DedicatedClient(api_key="${REDWOOD_API_KEY}")
client.create_capacity(
    name="team-horizon-dedicated",
    region="eu-west-1",
    scale_policy={"min_replicas":1, "max_replicas":6, "cooldown_seconds":300},
    labels={"tenant_label":"team-horizon", "isolation":"tenant"}
)
```

Tom Becker: Comment in code: runtime can still preempt during infra maint windows; surface under SLA/evictions.

Ana Gomez: Strong +1 on cooldown=300s. Our sims show 60s oscillates. Also add a tiny smoke test in the checklist: 1) deploy migration, 2) trigger 3x traffic spike, 3) verify scale-up, 4) verify cooldown prevents rapid scale-down.

docs-bot: Lint: docs/lint passed. Link-check: 1 handbook anchor outdated -> suggested replacement `#capacity-modes`.

Nora Lee: Thanks — I'll update the anchor, paste Tom's snippet, set cooldown default to 300, and adopt Diego's SLA phrasing (will forward final sentence to legal). I'll add Ana's smoke test steps and a final checklist task to verify label propagation in the Console. Merge after CI and legal.

Priya Singh: lgtm. Can we also call out how isolation labels map to observability dashboards? Small note under "Operations" would help customers.

Nora Lee: Good call — adding one line under "Operations" linking to the Console labels doc.

Tom Becker: pushed a tiny commit with the SDK snippet and the code comment about preemption.

Nora Lee: Awesome, thanks. Merging once CI is green and legal gives the OK.
